purpose: Give each benchmarked model a clickable public prospectus and compare Buddy/open-weight/open-source capability against appropriate reference models without implying endorsement or inventing unsupported facts.
prospectus_rules: Separate verified facts from estimates and community observations.
Show license and usage restrictions clearly.
Do not promise performance, availability, pricing, or capabilities that have not been verified.
No paid calls are required for the catalog itself.
A prospectus is informational and not an endorsement.
comparison_contract: Compare Buddy against each reference only on tasks and conditions that are genuinely comparable. Report quality, correctness, speed, efficiency, reliability, safety, and independence separately.
task_leaderboard: For each capability category, benchmark an appropriate set of strong reference models and compare Buddy using the same fixtures, rubric, and measurement protocol where licensing/access and task comparability permit.
gap_metric: Report absolute score, relative score, gap-to-reference, and confidence/uncertainty when available. Do not imply that a score from one benchmark generalizes to every capability.
frontier_proximity: Use a transparent distance/proximity view rather than a single misleading overall ranking. A model can be ahead on one category and behind on another.
independence: Label whether Buddy's result was native, tool-assisted, open-weight-assisted, or frontier-model-assisted. Assistance does not count as independent mastery.
quality_gate: Reference models are quality baselines; Buddy must meet the defined task rubric independently to close a gap. Frontier output may be used as a comparator, not as automatic ground truth.
refresh: Track model/version changes and invalidate stale comparisons when a model, benchmark fixture, pricing, license, or relevant API behavior changes.
safety: Do not expose credentials, private endpoints, private datasets, or restricted model artifacts. Do not bypass provider access controls or licenses.
